# Progress

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/northstar.py progress` and by the Stop hook after every Claude Code turn. Edits are overwritten. -->

**Overall: 58.5%** of the way to the agent described in [NORTHSTAR.md](NORTHSTAR.md). Every number below is computed from evidence (graded eval results, run traces, the lesson store), never from a claim: code that exists but hasn't moved a measured outcome earns nothing. Overall is the plain mean of five pillars.

| Pillar | What it means | Progress | |
|---|---|---|---:|
| **Frontier** | measured honestly, on every axis at once, against something other than itself | `████████░░` | 75% |
| **Intelligence** | solves tasks it has never seen, and updates itself from every attempt | `█████░░░░░` | 51% |
| **Self-improving** | gets better without a human in the loop, and proves it on tasks it was never tuned on | `████░░░░░░` | 42% |
| **Cost** | few dollars and seconds per solved task | `███████░░░` | 66% |
| **Autonomy** | needs little of your attention, delivers a lot of value, and stays safe | `██████░░░░` | 59% |

## Where the numbers come from

The scorecard is `scripts/northstar.py` (standard library only). It reads files the work produced on the build Mac: eval results in `evals/`, run traces in `runs/`, the lesson store in `experience/` and the tuning ledger `profiles/ledger.jsonl`. The first three hold screenshots and traces of a real screen, so they stay on that Mac and out of git: a fresh clone can read this page but can't regenerate it. The latest sealed-suite run scored here is from 2026-11-02.
